Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

// Get or Set Time Management Configuration command
This command is used to get or set the time management configuration.


| Head  |Len   |Cmd  | Flag |Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes)   |0x57  | xx |0x02   |

If FLAG is 1, time management is disabled.
If FLAG is 0, the time management status is returned.

Device response:

| Head  |Len   |MainCmd| Cmd |AckCode|Time flag  |Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes)|0x4   | 0x57 |0x55 | xx (1 bytes) | xx |0x02   |


Time_flag: 1 if there is time management configuration, 0 if there is no time management configuration.
